messages.author: 734ff539e5ba1510
messages.subject: QTL analysis AMPRIL population
parts:
Hi,

I was wondering if it is possible to use the Arabidopsis Multi Parental RIL (AMPRIL) for QTL analysis. I already ran in to some problem concerning the input. The population looks as follows:

Col-0
   x            --> E
Cvi                  
                       x           individuals EF01, EF02...EF48, but also reciprocal FE01, FE02...FE48 (all were selfed)
Sha
   x            --> F
Kyo


Ler
   x            --> G
An-1                 
                       x           individuals GH01, GH02...GH48, but also reciprocal HG01, HG02...HG50 (all were selfed)
Eri
   x            --> H
C24


So I have 8 founders, but only 4 are used to produce an individual (e.g. EF03, GE25, HE04).
In total I have 12 crosses: EF/FE/EG/GE/EH/HE/FG/GF/FH/HF/GH/HG

If it is possible to use R/qtl2, then how should I build the cross_info and what kind of crosstype should I assign?

Thank you.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] QTL analysis AMPRIL population
parts:
R/qtl2 can potentially be used for this purpose, but currently it only has facilities for analyzing the individual crosses, and not for the combined analysis. The EF population, for example, could be treated as "riself4".

karl
